national_news.title: Parliament passes bill to enhance funding and development of cooperative sector
bullets: The National Co-operative Development Corporation (NCDC) (Amendment) Bill, 2026 has been passed by Parliament.
The Bill aims to further amend the National Co-operative Development Corporation Act, 1962.
The legislation allows the Corporation to undertake activities in industrial goods and provide loans and grants directly to co-operatives.

national_news.title: Parliament passes Kerala (Alteration of Name) Bill, 2026, to change state name to Keralam
bullets: The Kerala Legislative Assembly had passed a resolution in 2024 requesting the Centre to change the state name from Kerala to Keralam.
The Lok Sabha had passed the legislation yesterday, and the Rajya Sabha approved it today.
The Bill seeks to change the name of the state of Kerala to Keralam in the First Schedule of the Constitution.

national_news.title: Lok Sabha refers FCRA Bill to JPC for further scrutiny
bullets: The bill aims to make the use of foreign contributions more transparent and accountable.
The Joint Parliamentary Committee will consist of 21 members from the Lok Sabha, nominated by the Speaker.
The committee will hold wider consultations on the Foreign Contribution (Regulation) Amendment Bill, 2026.

national_news.title: BRICS economies are major growth engines of global economy: FM Sitharaman
bullets: BRICS economies are among the major engines of global growth.
Public capital should act as a catalyst for private investment, not a substitute for it.
Maintaining stability and providing a predictable environment are crucial for building investor confidence.

national_news.title: DoT selects three Sanchar Mitras as envoys of ITU
bullets: The Department of Telecommunications has selected three Sanchar Mitras from India as Generation Connect Youth Envoys (GCYE) of the International Telecommunication Union (ITU).
The programme aims to provide young people with opportunities to contribute to national, regional, and global discussions and initiatives related to Information and Communication Technologies (ICTs).
The initiative aligns closely with the objectives of the Sanchar Mitra Scheme, which seeks to engage youth in digital transformation and inclusive digital development.

national_news.title: Thailand's Cabinet Approves Proposal to Enhance School Safety
bullets: Thailand's cabinet approved an Education Ministry's proposal to elevate school safety to a national agenda.
The move aims to strengthen prevention and response at educational institutions systematically.
All schools have been designated School Safety Zones and must set up centres for protection of rights, liberties, and safety.

national_news.title: Canadian Open Tennis: Men’s and women’s semifinals locked in
bullets: Iga Swiatek of Poland will face Elina Svitolina of Ukraine in the women's singles semifinals.
Elena Rybakina will meet Coco Gauff in the other women's singles semifinal.
The semifinals will take place in Toronto tomorrow morning.

national_news.title: India wins 3 gold, 1 silver, and 1 bronze in Commonwealth Fencing Championship
bullets: India won 3 gold, 1 silver, and 1 bronze medal in the Commonwealth Fencing Championship.
The championship was held in Lagos, Nigeria, and marked a stellar performance by the Indian team.
India's overall combined medal count reached 29, comprising 8 Gold, 7 Silver, and 14 Bronze.

national_news.title: Sports Ministry suspends TTFI's recognition till restoration of its governance structure
bullets: The Sports Ministry suspended the recognition of the Table Tennis Federation of India (TTFI) due to governance deficiencies.
TTFI failed to conduct elections on time, prompting the Ministry to issue a show cause notice.
The Indian Olympic Association (IOA) will form an ad-hoc committee to administer the sport in consultation with the international body (ITTF).

national_news.title: Indian Grandmaster R Praggnanandhaa defeats Javokhir Sindarov in Sinquefield Cup
bullets: Indian Grandmaster R Praggnanandhaa secured his first victory in the Sinquefield Cup.
The match was a part of the Grand Chess Tour, with the Sinquefield Cup being the penultimate event.
Praggnanandhaa dominated the game from start to finish, eventually turning the endgame in his favor.

national_news.title: India's retail inflation rises to 4.45%, remains above RBI's target of 4%
bullets: Retail inflation accelerated to 4.45% in July, above RBI's target of 4% for the second consecutive month.
Food prices remained elevated, contributing to the higher inflation reading.
Inflation in rural areas increased to 4.84%, higher than the overall retail inflation rate.

national_news.title: BRICS nations need stronger frameworks to mobilise private capital at scale: Nirmala Sitharaman
bullets: BRICS economies need to build greater confidence, stability, predictability, and credible long-term frameworks to unlock sustained private capital flows at scale.
Union Finance Minister Nirmala Sitharaman highlighted the role of multilateral development banks in de-risking investments and mobilizing private capital.
The statement was made during a discussion on the role of multilateral development banks in mobilizing private capital for sustainable development.

national_news.title: Vice-President flags off 'Har Ghar Tiranga Bike Rally 2026' in Delhi
bullets: Vice-President C P Radhakrishnan flagged off the 'Har Ghar Tiranga Bike Rally 2026' from Bharat Mandapam in New Delhi.
The rally is part of the ongoing Har Ghar Tiranga 2026 campaign dedicated to the National Song Vande Mataram.
Union Cabinet Ministers and Ministers of State were also present at the event.

national_news.title: Government Promotes Sustainable Growth of Data Centres through Energy-Efficient and Clean Energy Measures
bullets: The government is promoting sustainable growth of data centres through energy-efficient and clean energy measures.
Data centres are an integral component of the overall Digital India Infrastructure ecosystem.
The data centre industry in India has been growing at a steady pace, driven by increasing demand for data centre services.

national_news.title: India Reaffirms Commitment to Elephant Conservation on World Elephant Day 2026
bullets: India has 33 Elephant Reserves across the country.
Union Minister for Environment, Forest and Climate Change, Shri Bhupender Yadav, reaffirmed India’s commitment to securing a shared future for elephants and people.
Securing the future of elephants is linked to securing India's forests, biodiversity, and ecological heritage.

national_news.title: National Green Hydrogen Mission Advances Green Hydrogen Adoption in Petroleum and Refining Sector
bullets: The Government of India is implementing the National Green Hydrogen Mission (NGHM) to make India a global hub for green hydrogen production, usage, and export.
The NGHM aims to promote the adoption of green hydrogen in the petroleum and refining sector through the SIGHT (Strategic Interventions for Green Hydrogen Transition) Mode - 2B scheme.
A green hydrogen production capacity of 30 Kilo Tonnes Per Annum (KTPA) has been awarded under the SIGHT Mode - 2B scheme of the NGHM.

national_news.title: Rail Coach Factory Kapurthala To Roll Out First Rake Of LHB Coaches For Bangladesh
bullets: Rail Coach Factory in Kapurthala, Punjab, is set to roll out its first rake of LHB coaches for Bangladesh.
This is a significant development in the field of infrastructure and energy projects.
The LHB coaches are a type of high-speed train coach designed for efficient and comfortable travel.

national_news.title: MoHUA holds national conference on affordable housing; Rajiv Gauba calls for land and urban planning reforms
bullets: The Ministry of Housing and Urban Affairs (MoHUA) organised a National Conference on Affordable Housing Reforms.
Rajiv Gauba called for land and urban planning reforms during the conference.
The conference aimed to reimagine affordable housing as a sustainable ecosystem.

national_news.title: DPIIT, MSME Ministry sign MoU to propel India's GI products into global markets
bullets: The MoU aims to accelerate the commercialisation and quality enhancement of India's Geographical Indications (GI) products.
The partnership between DPIIT and MSME Ministry aims to promote India's GI products in global markets.
The MoU was signed on August 5 at Vanijya Bhawan in New Delhi.

national_news.title: Objective of Ayush Grid
bullets: Ayush Grid is a comprehensive IT backbone for the Ayush sector to digitize service delivery and strengthen transparency, efficiency, and governance.
The project aims to integrate healthcare, research, education, drug administration, capacity building, and medicinal plants under a single platform.
Ayush Grid is compliant with the Ayushman Bharat Digital Mission (ABDM) and has developed Ayush Hospital Management Information System (AHMIS).

national_news.title: Container Manufacturing Assistance Scheme: Building India's Maritime Future
bullets: The proposed Container Manufacturing Assistance Scheme (CMAS) has a ₹10,000 crore outlay to promote manufacturing, investment, and technology development across the container ecosystem.
The initiative aims to strengthen India's maritime capabilities, generate employment, and support India's long-term trade competitiveness.
The scheme is part of broader reforms in shipping, ports, and logistics to boost India's trade and manufacturing ambitions.

national_news.title: Implementation of Anemia Mukt Bharat Abhiyaan Operational Guidelines
bullets: The Government of India has released the Anemia Mukt Bharat Abhiyaan Operational guidelines to address anemia through a 7X7X7 strategy.
The guidelines focus on Testing, Treatment, Tracking, and Dietary Diversification to accelerate anemia reduction.
The 7X7X7 framework aims to achieve a significant reduction in anemia prevalence in the country.

national_news.title: The Micro, Small and Medium Enterprises Development (Amendment) Bill, 2026
bullets: The Bill updates the existing MSMED Act, 2006 to align its provisions with the requirements of the MSME sector.
The amendments aim to reduce payment-related constraints, make dispute resolution more time-bound and simplify compliance.
The broader objective is to facilitate the growth, development and competitiveness of the MSME sector.

national_news.title: Union Agriculture Minister Shri Shivraj Singh Chouhan launches National Scholarship Portal
bullets: Scholarships worth Rs 21.35 crore released to over 6,000 agriculture students through NSP-DBT
Union Minister stresses on practical training, timely assistance, and agricultural innovation
Emphasis on developing real skills through practical training in agriculture

bihar_news.title: Bihar CM Inspects Proposed Medical College Site in Gopalganj, Offers Guidance
bullets: Bihar CM inspected the proposed site for Maa Thawe Medical College and Hospital in Gopalganj.
The CM offered necessary directions for the project's progress.
He also performed puja and aradhana at Thawe Temple, praying for the state's prosperity, peace, and happiness.
